name: Slurp
notes: 5 photos: 2 were crisp printed menu boards (Slurps noodle soups, Rice Plates) used for most dishes; 1 was a photo of the in-store overhead menu boards, which added Specials/Sides items not on the printed boards; 2 were pictorial menu cards (dish photos with names only, no prices) and were skipped as redundant with the printed boards.

dishes.name: BBQ Pork & Wonton
dishes.description: Your choice of noodles with BBQ pork, shrimp, and pork wontons, Napa cabbage, carrots in a chicken broth, topped with green onions, cilantro, and fried garlic. (Soup optional)

dishes.name: Roast Duck
dishes.description: Your choice of noodles, roast duck, broccoli, and bean sprouts in a duck broth, topped with green onions, cilantro, and fried garlic.

dishes.name: Pho
dishes.description: Rice noodles in a chicken broth with your choice of sliced beef, chicken, mock duck, shrimp, or tofu, topped with Thai basil, green and white onions, jalapenos, cilantro, and fried garlic. ($12.99-$15.99)

dishes.name: Shrimp & Pork Wonton
dishes.description: Shrimp and pork wontons, Napa cabbage, and carrots in a chicken broth, topped with green onions, cilantro, and fried garlic. No noodles, soup optional. ($13.99-$14.99)

dishes.name: Chow Mein
dishes.description: Stir-fried noodles with Napa cabbage, white onions, green onions, carrots, bean sprouts, and your choice of beef, chicken, roast duck, BBQ pork, tofu, mock duck (vegan), shrimp, or vegetables. ($12.99-$15.99)

dishes.name: Beef Boat Noodle
dishes.description: Your choice of noodles, sliced beef, meatballs, broccoli, and bean sprouts in a beef broth, topped with green onions, cilantro, and fried garlic.

dishes.name: Tom Yum
dishes.description: Your choice of noodles in a Tom Yum soup broth with ground pork, BBQ pork, broccoli, bean sprouts, topped with green onions, cilantro and fried garlic. (Soup optional)

dishes.name: Crab Fried Rice
dishes.description: Jasmine rice stir-fried with crab meat, egg, peas, carrots, white and green onions.

dishes.name: Orange Chicken
dishes.description: Crispy orange chicken over Jasmine rice, topped with sesame seeds, cilantro, and an orange slice.

dishes.name: Spicy Crispy Chicken Rice
dishes.description: Fried crispy chicken with homemade chili sauce, topped with a fried egg and crispy basil. Your choice of Jasmine rice or noodles. (Spicy level 1-5)

dishes.name: BBQ Pork
dishes.description: BBQ pork over Jasmine rice, topped with BBQ sauce, cucumbers, and a fried egg.

dishes.name: Chinese Sausage Fried Rice
dishes.description: Jasmine rice stir-fried with Chinese sausage, egg, garlic, white onion, peas, and carrots.

dishes.name: Thai Crab Omelette
dishes.description: Thai omelette stuffed with crab meat over Jasmine rice, topped with cucumbers and cilantro.

dishes.name: Broccoli Stir Fly
dishes.description: Carrots and house-made sauce with the option of Chicken $13.99, Beef $14.99, or Shrimp $15.99.

dishes.name: Roast Duck
dishes.description: Roast duck over Jasmine rice and steamed vegetables, topped with savory duck sauce and fried garlic.

dishes.name: Hainan Chicken
dishes.description: Steamed chicken over Jasmine rice, topped with cilantro and ginger sauce.

dishes.name: Rice Combo
dishes.description: Orange chicken and BBQ pork over Jasmine rice.

dishes.name: Spicy Basil Steak Burrito
dishes.description: Ribeye steak stir-fried with Thai basil, Jasmine rice, and topped with a fried egg. (Spicy level 1-5)
